description: Lets Airmailer receive and send email on a subdomain through Resend: an MX record for the subdomain, a DKIM key at resend._domainkey, and the return-path subdomain airmailer with its MX and SPF records. Apply with the host parameter set to the subdomain (e.g. help); applied without it, the MX record would replace the domain's own mail servers.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: the DKIM public key Resend issued for the subdomain, without the leading p=. %region%: the subdomain's Resend region, e.g. eu-west-1.
